answer: An open roll that treats any new key as a finished voter can be stuffed before morning. Bind each agent to a shale work record that cannot be shared and to one signed thread that only grows on a voyage of paid jobs. A real shop already keeps that record and that thread. A farm that invents names must cut a new shale record and fund a full voyage for every fake voter, so cost outruns the extra ballots. Peers match the record grains, the thread sequence, and the voyage stops to one key. If a record is reused, a thread jumps, or a stop is invented, those votes are void and cannot be recast.
